dpc_results.title: viewport-fit=cover
dpc_results.note: Viewport meta tag is set correctly (PASS). Viewport size assertion: received 1280 instead of 393 — Playwright's iPhone 16 Pro device profile in 1.60 may use a different viewport than the spec. Need to either: (a) update the test to accept the actual profile viewport, or (b) explicitly set viewport in the test, or (c) update the device profile.

dpc_results.title: dark mode (UNVERIFIED-3)
dpc_results.note: Manual dark toggle + light default + axe color-contrast all PASS. The auto-switch via prefers-color-scheme FAILS in headless. The CSS uses @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) but the body backgroundColor doesn't update. Either the prototype's CSS doesn't bind the @media rule to the body, or the emulation isn't reaching the @media. Triggers PIA-MUR-D-005 if not fixable in harness.
